g10-history-uh2-t1.overview: General Background to Colonialism sits inside Africa and the Colonial Experience (1880s-1960s). Colonial rule over Africa is the focus of Unit 2 of Grade 10 History in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it explains colonialism, imperialism, and the shift to legitimate trade. Then it sets out the economic, political, and religious motives of European powers. Next, it follows the Scramble for Africa and the Berlin Conference of 1884 to 1885. Also it compares company rule, direct rule, indirect rule, and settler rule. Finally, it looks at early African resistance and the lasting impacts of colonial rule. Students will also learn how the colonial experience applies to real-life situations, such as borders and identity in Africa today.
